$comment: The packs this repository generates components for. Each is read from git at the pinned commit `ref` (a full SHA, never a branch), from the sibling checkout `checkout` when it holds that commit, else by a shallow fetch of `repository`. Adding a pack is a new entry here; moving a pack forward is a new `ref`. `minIcons` is the floor the count guard enforces, set a little under the measured count. `licence` is the artwork's SPDX expression; `attribution` lists the files, read at `ref`, copied to dist/<flavour>/<pack>/. `exclude` lists source SVGs the policy rejects, each with its reason; an entry that stops being rejected fails the build. ichava/icon-sets-bundled is not here: it is private, proprietary and for internal and client use only, so a public package cannot ship it. ichava/icon-sets-metronic is private and never shown publicly.

packs.$comment: Twemoji only. The pack's two OpenMoji sets are deprecated there and moved to ichava/icon-sets-openmoji, which the openmoji entry generates; carrying them here too would ship 7,132 icons twice.

exclude.reason: An unused xmlns:sodipodi declaration on <svg>, left by Inkscape, at 25280ae1. icon-sets-sync's sanitiser strips sodipodi:docname but keeps namespace declarations, and this policy rejects any attribute not on the allow-list. The fix belongs in icon-sets-sync (drop unused namespace declarations) or upstream. Measured 2026-11-05: the only 2 of 8,568.
